content: In this work we have briefly introduced the problems related to data privacy protection in clinical domain. We have also described some of the groundbreaking advances on the Natural Language Processing field due to the appearance of Transformers-based deep-learning architectures and transfer learning from very large general-domain multilingual corpora, focusing our attention in one of its most representative examples, Google's BERT model.
